newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita rises sharply in brisk demand.
newsitem.headline: Merita rises sharply in brisk demand.

text.p: Shares in Finnish banking group Merita rose sharply in brisk trade on Wednesday on a wide stockmarket rally, but also amid rumours of a share issue, brokers said.
At 1610/1310 GMT, Merita traded at a life-high 23.50 markka, up 1.50 markka or almost seven percent. Dealing was lively, with volume rising above 115 million markka.

Brokers said Merita was benefiting from its stockholdings as the bourse was in bullish mood, but some said it was boosted by market talk, including one rumour that it was planning a share issue to repay its state capital certificates.
The rumoured share issue was linked by brokers to speculation about further merger activity in the Nordic banking sector.
